title: Ants
paras: Butterflies, bees, and mosquitoes are insects too.
Ants live almost everywhere on Earth.
Most ants live in nests in the ground.
Ants can be black, red, and brown.
Ants can be yellow and green too.
Ants have three main body parts.
They are the head, thorax, and abdomen.
An ant's head has two eyes, a mouth, and two antennae.
Ants live together in a group called a colony.
Each ant has an important job to do in the colony.
Ant colonies have three main members.
They are the queen, female workers, and males.
Ants protect plants by eating other insects.
Their underground homes keep the soil healthy.

notes.tf: 4번이 가장 헷갈립니다 — 개미는 식물을 먹는 게 아니라 다른 곤충을 먹어서 식물을 지켜 줘요. 문장을 끝까지 읽어야 걸리는 문항이에요. 3번은 some을 only로 바꾼 함정입니다.
notes.trace: 첫 문장이 다음 세 유닛의 예고입니다 — 나비(45)·벌(44)·모기(46)가 다 이어서 나와요. 쓰면서 "다음엔 벌 나온다" 하고 알려 주면 아이가 기대합니다. 쉼표 자리도 함께 봐 주세요.
